_comment: Terms that mark a skin `mature` when they appear in its name, description, author, tags, source or URLs (scripts/content_policy.py). Matching ignores case and treats every non-alphanumeric character as a word break. `words` match whole words only. `substrings` match anywhere, so list only terms that cannot occur inside an innocent word. Keep this list conservative: a false positive hides a skin from families' default view until someone reviews it, a miss is caught by the Report link.
